study.title: Effects of Electroacupuncture on Intraoperative and Postoperative Analgesic Requirement
study.comparator_class: GroupI preop placebo tap/tape needle without penetration/no current45min
study.independence: One3-arm trial with sharedI control. IIvsI is matched-timing blinded comparison; IIIvsI differs in timing and III awareness. No demonstrated duplicate among assigned trials.
study.identity_notes: 0–24h includes recovery-room stay but inclusion of fixed pre-end-of-surgery0.1mg/kg morphine not explicit. PreopEA described45min, discussion says some continued underGA to surgery end. Table2VAS is mean over24h, not exact24h. PONV46.6% of30 does not match conventional one-decimal rounding of14/30=46.7%; no unqualified direct event count.

final.Other analysis eligibility: Direct weight-normalized 24-h morphine endpoint; pool only if protocol permits mg/kg or a prespecified standardization method
final.Source-QC issue: Do not convert with mean weight; fixed0.1mg/kg dose at muscle closure may be included; clarify window/all-exposure coverage.
